regime.label: Protection zone with the long-gamma cushion rebuilt above spot and an amplifying -6,911 GEX strip immediately below it
evidence: +2,463 net GEX in the +/-1.5% band around 1068.3, up from +673 on 29 Aug and back inside the +2,172 to +3,318 window norm; total chain GEX +3,492.
1098.7 gamma flip sits 30.4 points above spot versus a 41.8-point gap on 29 Aug, but the strikes below spot still carry -6,911 net GEX against +10,402 above - the hinge is at spot, not at the flip.
+1.76 at 25D and +4.62 at 10D is the widest skew of the 8-session window, up from +0.13 on 25 Aug, with put OI at an 8-session high 41,073 and P/C OI 2.24.
16,011 put OI at 910 traded only 49 lots and sits 158 points (-14.8%) below spot - structural, not live; the 1100 call wall shed 143 OI on 126 lots, so neither headline wall is being reinforced.

S50U26.today_summary: 1068.3 settled +2.9 points and 1.7 below the 1070 max pain that has anchored 7 of the last 8 sessions. Net dealer gamma in the +/-1.5% band around spot rebuilt to +2,463 from +673 on 29 Aug and the flip fell to 1098.7 from 1107.2, restoring a dampening cushion above spot while the 970-1060 strip still carries -6,911 net GEX. Call OI was retired at every strike from 1010 to 1130 (-780 total) against flat put OI, and 25D skew widened to +1.76, the steepest of the window. P/C volume doubled to 1.77 from 0.89 on 1,382 put lots, with the live build at 1000-1040 (+121 OI on 500 lots) rather than at any near-money wall.
what_changed: ATM-zone net GEX rebuilt to +2,463 from +673 and total chain GEX to +3,492 from +2,019 - the cushion that collapsed on 29 Aug is back.
Gamma flip fell to 1098.7 from 1107.2, cutting the spot-to-flip gap to 30.4 points from 41.8.
Call OI shed 780 contracts across every strike from 1010 to 1130 while put OI held flat at 41,073, lifting P/C OI to an 8-session high 2.24.
P/C volume ratio doubled to 1.77 from 0.89 on 1,382 put lots, with +121 put OI built at 1000-1040 on 500 lots - protection rolled down, not added at the money.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Across the five sessions since 25 Aug the anchor fell 4.8 points to 1068.3 while max pain held 1070, so the structure has not moved even though price has. Put OI added 1,726 contracts to 41,073 against a 52-contract fall in calls, pushing P/C OI from 2.14 to 2.24 and 25D skew from +0.13 to +1.76 - a steady insurance bid rather than a directional bet. Total chain GEX never changed sign across eight sessions (+2,019 to +6,337) and the 1100 call wall, 910 put wall, 1050 near put wall and ~1099 flip have not migrated once, so this is a settled burden map, not a repositioning. ATM IV compressed 0.28 points to 13.43% over the window and sits 1.01 below the 14.44% high of 24 Aug, pricing a smaller range even as the protection bid widens. The one genuine break in the pattern was 29 Aug, when the ATM cushion briefly collapsed to +673 and the flip spiked to 1107.2; today's snap back to +2,463 and 1098.7 says that was a one-session dislocation, not a regime change.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1100/1120
strategies.rationale: +10,402 net GEX above 1068.3 and a 1098.7 flip mean dealer hedging dampens rallies into 1100, which is 3.5x the 9.04-point daily sigma away; the 1100 wall lost 143 OI on 126 lots today, so it is decaying rather than being defended by fresh buyers.
strategies.defined_risk: Net credit ~3.05 points at mid (4.50 - 1.45). Max loss = 20 wing - 3.05 = 16.95 points, or 3,390 baht at 200/point. Breakeven 1103.05.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1100, which clears the call wall and the 1098.7 gamma flip together.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050/1020
strategies.rationale: -6,911 net GEX below spot puts dealers in amplifying territory under 1050, and ATM IV at 13.43% is 1.01 points below the 24 Aug window high so the wing is comparatively cheap; the +121 put OI built at 1000-1040 on 500 lots today is the same roll-down already underway.
strategies.defined_risk: Net debit ~5.05 points at mid (9.50 - 4.45), which is the max loss - 1,010 baht at 200/point. Max gain 24.95 points, breakeven 1044.95.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1080, where the +2,737 GEX strike puts dealers firmly long gamma and downside vol gets absorbed.

strategies.name: Financed tail collar - 1050/1020 put debit spread funded by the 1100/1120 call credit spread
strategies.rationale: Pairs the two axes this regime actually splits on: sell the dampened upside above the 1098.7 flip to pay for the amplifying downside below 1050, so 28 days of carry inside the 1050-1100 range costs 2.00 points instead of 5.05.
strategies.defined_risk: Net debit ~2.00 points. Max loss 22.00 points (4,400 baht at 200/point) on a settle above 1120; 2.00 points if it settles between 1050 and 1100. Max gain 28.00 points below 1020.

S50U26.prediction: 1068.3 should hold a 1050-1090 range with the 1070 max pain as the magnet: 1 sigma daily is 9.04 points and 1 sigma to the 29 Sep expiry is roughly 40 points, or 1028-1109. The asymmetry is the part that matters - +10,402 net GEX above spot dampens rallies into 1098.7, while -6,911 below spot means a break of 1050 gets amplified rather than absorbed. A close above 1100 invalidates the read outright: it clears the flip and the call wall together and dealer hedging stops capping.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position is being recommended. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no delivery-driven pinning: the 1070 max pain is a tendency, not a level that must hold, and expiry is still 28 days out. Defined risk is not small risk - the 1100/1120 call spread loses 16.95 points and the collar 22.00 points at their worst. The 910 put wall (16,011 OI on 49 lots, 14.8% below spot) is stale structural OI and must not be read as active support.
